title: Harden an Edge-to-edge Checkout
prompt: Build a scrolling checkout with app bar, fixed action, focused fields, and animated keyboard behaviour across gesture and three-button navigation.
successCriteria: Focused fields and actions remain reachable with IME open.
System-bar icons retain contrast over all backgrounds.
hints: Write down the ownership and failure contract before choosing library APIs.
Prove one adverse or lifecycle case before improving presentation.
solutionOutline: Model immutable inputs, outputs, events, and failures at the boundary.
Implement the smallest correct path and verify every success criterion.
verification: Run deterministic state or protocol tests.
Inspect the relevant accessibility, lifecycle, concurrency, or network boundary.
